changelog: **Bug reports, phase 2: session replay (#3131):** an rrweb recording of the last ~90 s (`FEEDBACK_REPLAY_SECONDS`, 30–300) can be attached to an in-app bug report. Recorded only in the browser's memory (`src/lib/feedbackRecorder.ts`, rrweb `2.1.7`) into a rolling buffer that starts on a full snapshot (`ReplayBuffer`, checkout every window/3), with `maskAllInputs`, `.rr-block` / `[data-private]` / the feedback panel blocked, no canvas/inlined images; started on sign-in, forgotten on sign-out. A ticked-by-default checkbox in the form; on Send the buffer is gzipped in the browser and posted as a `replay` part, which `POST /api/support/reports` accepts only while `FEEDBACK_REPLAY_ENABLED` is on (unset = on in preview builds, off in production), only as gzip ≤ 8 MB that decodes within an 80 MB ceiling to rrweb events with a full snapshot (`checkReplayEvents()`), and stores as `SupportReportFile` kind `REPLAY` (new enum value, additive). Admin detail plays it with `rrweb-player`, with console errors, failed requests and the send moment marked on the timeline. Pure rules in `src/lib/feedbackReplayRule.ts` (unit-tested); `e2e/feedback-replay.spec.ts` pins that no request carries the recording before Send and that a typed value never reaches it.

en: Bug reports can now include a short replay of the last moments on screen, so the support team sees exactly what happened. Anything you typed and private fields are never recorded, and nothing is sent until you press Send.
tr: Hata bildirimlerine artık ekrandaki son anların kısa bir kaydı eklenebiliyor; destek ekibi tam olarak ne olduğunu görüyor. Yazdıkların ve gizli alanlar asla kaydedilmez, Gönder’e basana kadar hiçbir şey gönderilmez.
de: Fehlermeldungen können jetzt eine kurze Wiedergabe der letzten Momente auf dem Bildschirm enthalten, damit das Support-Team genau sieht, was passiert ist. Eingaben und private Felder werden nie aufgezeichnet, und nichts wird gesendet, bevor du auf Senden drückst.
